spec.goal: Eliminate the remaining live-mode startup RGB placeholder flash by seeding the initial cursor color before the first HUD draw without turning steady-state live sampling into a blocking path.
success_criteria: Entering screenshot mode no longer renders the HUD's RGB field as `???` on the normal startup path when synchronous startup seeding succeeds.
The startup seed stays scoped to first-paint/live warmup behavior and does not make steady-state cursor sampling blocking.
Startup sampling avoids capturing the HUD's own pixels during the one-shot seed path.
Focused regression coverage locks in the startup seed behavior and the hidden-before-first-draw HUD contract.
Fresh verification evidence covers the touched rsnap-overlay surface after the change.
constraints: Keep the change scoped to macOS live startup sampling and first-paint HUD behavior in rsnap-overlay.
Do not add arbitrary fixed delays to hide the placeholder.
Do not broaden live steady-state sampling latency by replacing the existing nonblocking fast path.

tasks.title: Shape the startup-only seed path
tasks.objective: Confirm where the one-shot startup RGB seed must run so it can populate state before first HUD draw without self-capturing the HUD window.
outputs: A concrete startup seed insertion point and capture source.
verification: Trace OverlaySession::start(), create_hud_window(), initialize_cursor_state(), and the HUD redraw visibility path.

tasks.title: Implement startup RGB seeding before first HUD draw
tasks.objective: Add a startup-only synchronous RGB seed path, keep the HUD initially hidden until the first draw, and preserve the nonblocking steady-state live sampling path.
outputs: Updated startup flow and capture helper usage in rsnap-overlay.
verification: The initial live HUD path can populate state.rgb before the first visible HUD draw when startup seeding succeeds.
steady-state live sampling still uses the existing nonblocking path.

tasks.title: Add regression coverage and verify
tasks.objective: Lock in the startup seed behavior with focused tests and run fresh verification commands for the touched overlay surface.
outputs: Focused regression tests and recorded verification evidence.

triggers: Avoiding startup self-capture requires a wider overlay-window lifecycle rewrite rather than a scoped startup seed.
The startup seed path needs a broader live-frame stream contract change that would affect steady-state sampling latency.
Verification shows the placeholder flash is caused by a different first-paint path than the current startup RGB state.

evidence: Task 1 evidence: the color jitter came from mixing two different startup sources. The first visible seed came from a pre-focus path, while the later steady-state sample came from post-focus ScreenCaptureKit frames after the overlay app had already taken focus and underlying UI state could change.

Task 2 outcome: the first post-fix implementation still allowed startup jitter because `seed_startup_live_cursor_rgb` accepted any cached `latest_cursor_sample()` frame from the live stream, including a stale frame captured before `focus_live_capture_window()` completed.

Task 2 outcome: OverlaySession::start now records a `min_captured_at` timestamp immediately after requesting overlay focus, and the startup seed waits briefly for a ScreenCaptureKit sample whose `captured_at` is newer than that focus request before the first visible HUD draw.

Task 2 outcome: the old pre-focus CoreGraphics startup seed path remains removed, and the startup live-stream seed now also rejects pre-focus cached ScreenCaptureKit frames so the first visible RGB matches the steady-state source and freshness contract.
Task 3 outcome: focused regression tests still cover monitor lookup without windows and preservation or clearing of pre-seeded live RGB during startup cursor-state initialization.
